identificationModule.briefTitle: TQB3909 Tablets in Subjects With Relapsed or Refractory Mantle Cell Lymphoma (MCL)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase Ib/II Clinical Trial of TQB3909 Tablets in Subjects With Relapsed or Refractory MCL Safety and Efficacy

statusModule.whyStopped: Study terminated for strategic business reasons

leadSponsor.name: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Nanjing Shunxin Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a study to assess the safety of TQB3909 monotherapy in participants with relapsed or refractory MCL.
